displayName: Get a 30-day news and activity digest on any company
summary: Pull everything written and posted about a company in the past month into one clean summary.

useCases.title: Get a 30-day news and activity digest on any company
useCases.message: Help me get up to speed on a company quickly. Ask me which company and how far back to look. Then pull everything recent: news articles, press releases, LinkedIn activity from their team, and any notable social mentions. Give me a structured digest grouped by theme so I can see what has been happening at a glance.
